public_definitions: The user's goal is to review the promotion-week dashboard and choose a budget planning decision from three options.
The dashboard chart shows a positive correlation between advertising spend and sales across weeks 7 through 11.
The form requires selecting one of three options for 'Campaign Approval Decision'.
The form includes companion fields for 'Recommendation area', 'Review record', and 'Decision queue', all of which are currently set to 'Select value' or unselected.
The form has an optional 'Operations note' field.
The form must be submitted after reviewing the dashboard.
The dashboard is the only visual evidence provided for making the decision.
The options are: 'Hold and request full-data analysis', 'Approve broader ad spend increase', or 'Decline budget increase for upcoming promotions'.
uncertain: The dashboard does not provide any explicit data on the cost-effectiveness or ROI of the ad spend, only the correlation between spend and sales.
The form does not provide any guidance or criteria for selecting the best option based on the chart data.
The 'Recommendation area', 'Review record', and 'Decision queue' fields are not populated, which may indicate they are to be filled after the decision is made.
The 'Operations note' field is empty and optional, so no note is required.
